headline: Tencent's hy4 keeps its all-time share record going at 11.3%, now three days running
summary: Tencent's hy4-20261104 is on a three-day streak at the top of the all-time token share records, and Tencent as a provider is the week's biggest climber. DeepSeek still holds the top spot, but the top two providers together now account for 49.7% of tokens.
highlights: Day 3 of Tencent's hy4-20261104 holding the all-time token share record at 11.3%.
Tencent as a provider sits at 12.4% today, up 1.6% on the day and 7.0% over the week, the biggest weekly gain in the provider table.
DeepSeek still can't be knocked off the podium: 37.3% provider share, though down 2.6% over seven days.
DeepSeek and Tencent together hold 49.7% of tokens, and the top three (adding OpenAI) reach 56.5%.
Moonshot's kimi-k3.1-pro set a fresh all-time record at 3.1%, jumping five spots to eighth on the day.
